meta.title: Merkel cell carcinoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Merkel cell carcinoma (localized, node-positive, and metastatic), adult
meta.population: Adults with Merkel cell carcinoma - THE VIRUS-MADE SKIN CANCER: roughly 80% carry clonally integrated Merkel cell polyomavirus (the discovery paper PMID-verified; the percentage memory-grade, phrased as roughly) and the rest are UV-driven with high tumor mutational burden (the virus-negative mutational-spectrum receipt PMID-verified) - one clinic, two etiologies, one immunogenic disease. THE INVERTED DENOMINATOR HONESTY: unlike its BCC and cSCC neighbors, MCC IS registry-tracked - SEER counts it (~2,500 US cases/yr verified; the ~3,000 figure memory-grade and slightly high), so this trainer's incidence numbers are registry-grade where its neighbors' are estimates. It is rare and genuinely lethal (roughly twice as lethal as melanoma overall - the stage-for-stage precision was NOT verified and is not claimed). THE IO-FIRST CHAPTER is the spine, taught through the durability lesson: chemotherapy's verified receipt is ORR 55% with median PFS 94 DAYS - high response is a trap; durability, not response rate, is the endpoint - and the property suite enforces that the chemotherapy card never outranks the immunotherapy card.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the virus-made skin cancer. THE DURABILITY LESSON is the spec's centerpiece, property-enforced: chemotherapy in metastatic MCC has a VERIFIED receipt of ORR 55% but median PFS 94 days and median OS 9.5 months (PMID-matched) - while first-line pembrolizumab runs ORR 56% with 24-month PFS 48.3% (PMID-matched): nearly identical response rates, utterly different durations, and the chemotherapy card is architecturally forbidden from outranking the immunotherapy card. meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: AJCC 8th edition MCC staging (memory-grade this sweep - not verified; none fabricated) operationalized here as the stage router: localized vs node-positive vs metastatic; SLNB is routine in clinically node-negative disease on the verified ~30% occult-metastasis receipt (29.6% of 736 sentinel sites, PMID-matched; Mayo 26% corroborator matched)
meta.response: ORR/duration for the advanced chapter at their verified grades (pembrolizumab first-line ORR 56% with 24-month PFS 48.3%, PMID-verified; chemotherapy ORR 55% with mPFS 94 days and mOS 9.5 months, PMID-verified - the durability contrast IS the response standard); the AMERK serology artifact for surveillance (52% seropositive vs 1% healthy, PMID-verified)

Newly diagnosed.name: Wide excision + SLNB + adjuvant RT per features (localized)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the localized standard (NCCN secondhand; SLNB receipt verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified SLNB receipt + convention; figure flagged teaching estimate
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: surgery + an RT course - front-loaded against a fast disease
Newly diagnosed.patient: For disease confined to the skin: surgery with a sentinel-node check, usually followed by radiation - this cancer responds well to radiation, and the node check matters because spread is invisible a third of the time.

Newly diagnosed.name: Nodal-basin therapy + the read-out adjuvant shelf (node-positive)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the node-positive standard (NCCN secondhand) + the read-out shelf at its honest grade
Newly diagnosed.evidence: convention + three read-out adjuvant trials (all secondhand or PMID-flagged); figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.patient: When lymph nodes are involved: treating the node basin with surgeryovsand/or radiation - and an honest conversation about preventive immunotherapy, which three trials have now tested with mixed answers and no approved drug yet.

Newly diagnosed.name: Immunotherapy first (metastatic - the durability chapter)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the metastatic first-line standard (NCCN-preferred IO-first, secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified first-line receipts (ORR/PFS snippet-verified); survival figure flagged teaching estimate
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the checkpoint ledger; rejection-risk care in the immunosuppressed (transferred lesson)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For spread disease: immunotherapy first - it works in about half of patients and, crucially, it LASTS, which the older chemotherapy does not.

Newly diagnosed.name: Platinum/etoposide chemotherapy (the high-response trap - carded to teach)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: post-IO / palliative convention - never preferred first (NCCN secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: VERIFIED series receipt (ORR, mPFS, mOS all snippet-verified) - the registry's cleanest durability contrast
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: platinum/etoposide ledger - real cost for a 94-day median benefit
Newly diagnosed.patient: The older chemotherapy shrinks this cancer just as often as immunotherapy does - and the shrinkage typically lasts only about three months: that contrast is the most important fact in this disease.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care

Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice - with palliative radiation often useful for this radiation-sensitive cancer.

refs.label: THE VIRUS-MADE RECEIPTS: Feng/Shuda/Chang/Moore, 'Clonal integration of a polyomavirus in human Merkel cell carcinoma' (Science 2008;319:1096-1100 - PMID 18202256, pubmed-url-match) - MCPyV discovered by digital transcriptome subtraction, clonally integrated; the ~80% viral fraction memory-grade (phrased 'roughly'). The dual-etiology fork verified: 'The Distinctive Mutational Spectra of Polyomavirus-Negative MCC' (PMID 26238782, matched) - the UV/TMB-high road. Large-T IHC prognostic receipt 20041469 (matched, supporting)

THE INVERTED DENOMINATOR: SEER TRACKS MCC - registry-grade incidence receipts both matched: 'The epidemiology of MCC in the United States' 2025 (PMID 40345546: ~0.68-0.7/100k = ~2,500 cases/yr 2013, roughly stable) + projected-increase paper (29102486, matched). The briefing's ~3,000 memory-grade and slightly high. Lethality: roughly twice melanoma's OVERALL (the stage-for-stage phrasing NOT verified - deliberately softened). The registry finally counts a skin cancer - said as the inversion it is vs the skin-bcc/skin-scc trainers

THE 30%-INVISIBLE RECEIPT: 'SLNB in MCC: 15-yr institutional experience...721 reported cases' (PMID 26480031, pubmed-url-match): 29.6% of 736 sentinel sites POSITIVE in clinically node-negative disease; Mayo corroborator 26% (PMID 29549898, matched) - why SLNB is routine and why the stage gate waits. AJCC 8th-edition staging memory-grade (none fabricated)

PEMBROLIZUMAB FIRST-LINE, the durable half: CITN-09/KEYNOTE-017 first report (Nghiem, NEJM 2016 - PMID 27093365, pubmed-url-match) + JCO 2019 update (PMID 30726175, matched): ORR 56% (CR 24%), 24-month PFS 48.3%, median PFS 16.8 months - ALL verified snippet. KEYNOTE-913 confirmatory first-line receipt matched (39377880). FDA 2018-12 (memory-grade date)

AVELUMAB - the first-ever MCC approval, with an honest discrepancy: JAVELIN Merkel 200 primary (Kaufman, Lancet Oncol 2016;17:1374-85, DOI 10.1016/S1470-2045(16)30364-3) - PMID NEVER url-matched: FLAGGED, journal/DOI-cited; ORR 31.8% (CR 9.1%) - the briefing's '~33%' CORRECTED; long-term follow-up PMID 32414862 matched. FDA accelerated 2017-03-23 (FIRST-EVER MCC approval). CONVERSION TO FULL: the trials sweep sourced full/traditional approval 2023-09 (JAVELIN Parts A+B; ESMO Open + Drugs.com); the anchors pass could NOT confirm - DISCREPANCY CARRIED HONESTLY, flagged for FDA-notice re-check. THE FALSE-MEMORY TRAP (9th premise correction): the briefing's '~2025 withdrawal/label change' is FALSE - the real 2023 event was Merck KGaA regaining exclusive worldwide rights from the Pfizer alliance (commercial, not regulatory). No withdrawal is taught
refs.src: Lancet Oncol (PMID flagged) + FDA history (secondhand, discrepancy flagged)

refs.label: RETIFANLIMAB (Zynyz): POD1UM-201 (NCT03599713), the primary paper now MATCHED and read firsthand 2026-09-10 - J Immunother Cancer 2025;13(8), PMID 40796223, clearing the previous PMID flag: open-label single-arm phase II, 101 chemotherapy-naive patients with recurrent locally advanced or metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma at 34 sites, retifanlimab 500 mg every 4 weeks for up to 2 years. ORR 54.5% (95% CI 44.2-64.4), of which complete response 17.8% (18 patients) and partial response 36.6% (37); disease control rate 60.4%; median duration of response not reached in complete responders and 25.3 months in partial responders; median PFS 16.0 months; median OS not reached with 63% alive at 3 years; grade 3 immune-related adverse events in 11 patients (10.9%). The secondhand figures previously shown - 'ORR 52%, DoR >=6mo 76% / >=12mo 62%' - are superseded; ORR is 54.5% and the duration-of-response landmarks appear nowhere in the publication. FDA accelerated 2023-03 -> CONVERTED TO TRADITIONAL/FULL approval 2025-12-17 (secondhand) - the chain's second conversion, NEW currency this sweep

CheckMate 358 neoadjuvant nivolumab (Topalian, JCO 2020 - PMID 32324435, pubmed-url-match): pCR 47.2% (17/36 resected; n=39 dosed) - verified snippet. THE ABSENCE HONESTY: nivolumab has NO FDA approval in MCC (confirmed) - neoadjuvant pCR and ADMEC-O DFS data never yielded a label; nivolumab in MCC is off-label/investigational, said

THE DURABILITY LESSON'S VERIFIED RECEIPT: 'Response rates and durability of chemotherapy among 62 patients with metastatic MCC' (Iyer/Nghiem 2016 - PMID 27431483, pubmed-url-match): first-line ORR 55% (13% CR + 42% PR), median PFS 94 DAYS, median OS 9.5 months - ALL verified snippet. Same response rate as pembrolizumab, none of the duration - the two-column table this trainer exists to teach, property-enforced (chemo never outranks IO)

THE READ-OUT ADJUVANT SHELF - three verdicts, no approval, no drug carded (property-enforced): STAMP = ECOG-ACRIN EA6174, NCT03712605 (the briefing's 'SWOG S2015' CORRECTED - the 8th premise correction) - CLOSED and READ OUT (ESMO 2025): NO significant RFS/OS benefit; distant-metastasis-free signal only (~42% lower distant-met risk; 2-yr RFS 73% vs 66% - secondhand); ADAM (NCT03271372, adjuvant avelumab, node-positive - the FIRST-EVER US MCC phase 3): positive relapse signal, ASCO 2026 LBA9504 (secondhand); ADMEC-O (adjuvant nivolumab): DFS-positive (24-mo 84% vs 73%) but EX-US (Germany/Netherlands; Lancet 2023 PMID FLAGGED, journal-cited). I-MAT (NCT04291885) status UNVERIFIED. No confirmed open US adjuvant door

THE SEROLOGY ARTIFACT (unique among the registry's skin trainers): Paulson, 'Viral oncoprotein antibodies as a marker for recurrence of MCC: prospective validation' (Cancer 2017 - PMID 27925665, pubmed-url-match): 52% of MCC patients seropositive (114/219) vs 1% of healthy controls - verified snippet; splits surveillance into titer-tracked vs imaging-heavy roads (AMERK, Fred Hutch/UW)

THE HOST AXIS, verified: SOT recipients with MCC - reduced PFS/OS/DSS independent of stage (PMID 24993599, pubmed-url-match: 24% dead within 1 yr vs 4%; 70% distant mets within 2 yr); the CLL bond (PMID 20587511, matched: most frequent associated neoplasia); mechanism/risk series 25575645 + 24978436 (matched, supporting). ARTACUS CONFIRMED to have included MCC (2 of 3 responded; no rejections) - now CLOSED (evidence, not referral)

Radiosensitivity: MCC responds briskly to RT (objective-response and single-fraction palliation receipts SECONDARY-GRADE - PMC-sourced, not pubmed-url-matched; marked); adjuvant RT per features is convention (NCCN secondhand); SBRT added to nivo+ipi bought NOTHING (Lancet 2022, secondhand) - the combination kept honest

THE FLAGGED FRONTIER: MATRiX (NCT05947500, tuvusertib ATR-inhibitor +/- avelumab, NCI/NCTN, anti-PD-(L)1-refractory MCC) - LOUD UNRESOLVED CONFLICT: one source reports SUSPENDED 2025-05 (enrollment re-plan) yet it READ OUT at ASCO 2026 (LBA9514, antitumor activity) - enrollment status UNVERIFIABLE from web alone, registry re-check REQUIRED; TRICK-MCC (NCT06056895, retifanlimab + anti-LAG-3 + anti-TIM-3): ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING (closed to new patients); ATTAC-MCC (NCT02584829, MCPyV T cells + avelumab + RT/IFN-beta) status UNVERIFIED. The refractory space is real and entirely behind flags

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

IFx-2.0 phase 3 (NCT06947928, TuHURA Biosciences): personalized in-situ vaccine (Emm55 plasmid) + pembrolizumab vs placebo + pembrolizumab, CPI-naive advanced/metastatic MCC - randomized placebo-controlled REGISTRATION phase 3 (accelerated-approval design; FDA fast-track; IFx-2.0/IFx-Hu2.0 alias). FDA partial clinical hold (manufacturing) LIFTED 2026-01; US sites confirmed (UCSF listed); est. completion 2032 - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. The briefing's IFx memory VERIFIED REAL - the flagship open first-line door

Neoadjuvant nivolumab + relatlimab (NCT06151236): phase 2 single-arm, stage I-III resectable MCC - RECRUITING (verified Jan 2026 per source; primary completion Dec 2026) - web-verified 2026-08-20, re-check due. Beside it, read out and closed: neoadjuvant lenvatinib+pembrolizumab (NCT04869137, Moffitt) pCR 57.7% (secondhand)

FH-MCVA2TCR (NCT03747484, Fred Hutch): gene-modified MCPyV-specific TCR-T for metastatic/unresectable MCC - phase 1/2; 2026 recruiting status UNVERIFIED (web documents 2020-22 only): registry re-check REQUIRED before any referral - existence-only verification 2026-08-20. The virus-made cancer's most mechanistically apt refractory door, carried with its honest flag
